description: Issue #177 (b): the other half of the deny. This issue's PRODUCT is the verify runner itself — it is listed under `## 対象ファイル`, the deliverable heading #50 introduced — so the harness path is granted rather than denied. A deny with no door would be the failure #50 removed: an issue that maintains its own harness in-repo (this repository does) would be refused by the scope gate for writing exactly what it was told to write. The grant is never silent: `harness_path_in_scope` names the path, says why the default is deny, and drops the run to partial so a reviewer reads it before dispatch. No test companion is derived for a .sh file, so suspected_files is exactly the one declared path — the grant is as narrow as the declaration.

warning_details_include: can pass by rewriting the judge
